## Change

Describe the change and why it is useful.

## Evidence

- [ ] Tests or documentation checks run (include exact commands)
- [ ] Model or prompt changes include a baseline, chronological evaluation, sample size, uncertainty, and regression results
- [ ] Data source and redistribution rights are documented
- [ ] No raw provider data, personal data, credentials, or private operational details are included
- [ ] Any new dependency is justified and its license reviewed

## Limitations

Describe regressions, uncertainty, and what this change does not prove.
